verdict.rationale: Chroma Cloud is documented as a managed, serverless offering (chroma-docs-9/15) with a CLI that can create and interact with Cloud DBs (chroma-docs-5/14/23) and GitHub notes creating a DB in under 30 seconds (chroma-gh-1), corroborated by community reports of '0-ops' cloud use (chroma-comm-4). However, evidence lacks explicit documentation of a programmatic API/SDK (e.g. REST or Python API) for provisioning databases beyond the CLI. Missing for 10: dedicated API/SDK docs for programmatic provisioning, infrastructure-as-code examples, and independent hands-on confirmation of automated provisioning workflows.
